description: Metal-first MoE inference for Apple Silicon with bounded SSD expert streaming, qualified GGUF artifacts, and documented local API subsets.
rules: Treat README.md and docs/contracts/RUNTIME_SUPPORT.md as the human-readable support authority.
Treat docs/contracts/qwen-release.json as the machine-readable Qwen artifact authority.
Do not generalize qualified artifacts or hardware profiles to arbitrary GGUF files, model families, or Macs.
Use the hebrus command names in new examples; legacy names are compatibility aliases.
Treat benchmark results as condition-scoped evidence, not universal or cross-engine performance claims.
Describe the local API endpoints as documented subsets rather than full OpenAI or Anthropic compatibility.
